_comment: Reviewed organizational relationships between protocols. Announced common teams do not imply merged contracts, shared collateral, changed keys or legal novation.

groups.name: Formation
groups.summary: Orca and Loopscale announce a combined team under Formation; both remain operating products. Exact corporate transaction documents were not reviewed.
groups.operationalEffect: Official FAQs say positions, programmes, upgrade authorities and multisigs continue unchanged. This announcement review did not re-decode current protocol controls.
